about: Free tiers and plans for compute, CI and AI inference, public fields only. Built by tools/catalog.py; every row names the vendor page it was read on and the date. verified: true means every figure was read on that first-party page on that date; false means it was not re-read since.

rows.name: Blacksmith free tier
rows.price_note: Free minutes each month, then pay as you go.
rows.includes: 3,000 x64 2vCPU minutes per month per organization. ARM, Windows, macOS and larger runners draw these down at conversion rates: 1 ARM 2vCPU minute = 0.625, 1 Windows 2vCPU minute = 2, and macOS uses a 6.67 price ratio with a 6 vCPU minimum.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: Paid per minute: Ubuntu x64 $0.004, Ubuntu ARM $0.0025, Windows x64 $0.008, macOS M4 $0.08. Docker layer caching and sticky disks are $0.50/GB per month; static IPs are $100/IP per month.
rows.limits: Blacksmith docs state no concurrency limit on jobs or vCPUs. The pages do not say what happens when the free minutes run out.

rows.name: GitHub Enterprise Cloud (included Actions)
rows.price_note: USD per user per month. The pricing page says Enterprise now includes access to GitHub Copilot.
rows.includes: $300 per month of included Actions compute, which covers 50,000 Linux 2-core minutes at $0.006 (pricing page: 50,000 CI/CD minutes per month). 50 GB artifact storage, 10 GB cache per repository, 150 GB custom image storage. Larger runners, the GPU runner among them, can draw from the included amount.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: Past $300: Linux 2-core x64 $0.006/min, Linux 2-core arm64 $0.005/min, Linux 4-core GPU $0.052/min. Storage past the allowance: $0.25 per GB-month for artifacts and Packages, $0.07 for cache.
rows.limits: Past the included amount, usage bills the payment method on file. A budget set to stop usage can block Actions spend. Without a valid payment method, usage is blocked once included compute is used.

rows.name: GitHub Actions on GitHub Free
rows.price_note: GitHub Free plan. GitHub Pro is a paid plan with a larger allowance.
rows.includes: Private repositories: $12 of included compute per month on GitHub Free, with 500 MB artifact storage and 10 GB cache per repository. GitHub Pro gets $18 and 1 GB. At $0.006 per Linux 2-core minute, $12 covers 2,000 minutes and $18 covers 3,000 (computed here). Standard GitHub-hosted runners in public repositories are free and do not draw on the allowance.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: Per minute: Linux 1-core $0.002, Linux 2-core x64 $0.006, Linux 2-core arm64 $0.005, Windows 2-core $0.010, macOS 3 or 4-core $0.062. Extra storage $0.25 per GB-month.
rows.limits: 6 hours per job and 35 days per workflow run. 20 concurrent jobs on Free (40 on Pro), with at most 5 macOS jobs. Without a payment method, usage is blocked once the included amount is used. With a payment method on file, extra usage bills unless a budget stops it; the page states no default $0 budget.

rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: $0 within credit

rows.name: Claude Code on the web (cloud sessions)
rows.price_note: No separate charge for the cloud VM. Needs a paid plan: Pro is $20 billed monthly (claude.com/pricing). Usage counts toward the plan's limits.
rows.includes: One isolated Anthropic-managed VM per session, Ubuntu 24.04 on x86_64, with approximate ceilings of 4 vCPUs, 16 GB RAM and 30 GB disk that may change over time. The docs list no GPU. Available on Pro, Max, Ultra and Team plans, and to Enterprise users with premium or Chat + Claude Code seats.
rows.unit_cost_vs_payg: No per-VM charge. Usage draws on the plan's usage limits.
rows.limits: Cloud sessions share rate limits with all other Claude and Claude Code usage. Network access defaults to Trusted (allowlisted domains). Foreground commands wait 2 minutes by default (up to 10); a backgrounded command runs up to 30 more minutes. Sessions stop after inactivity and the VM is reclaimed. Repository cloning and pull requests need GitHub. Organizations with Zero Data Retention, HIPAA configuration or customer-managed keys cannot use cloud sessions.
